summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/invite-codes/[code]/join POST route now rejects signed student app-session cookies whose account is not a safe server identity before invite lookup or membership writes can run.

redGreenEvidence.observed: The unsafe signed student account regression failed with HTTP 400 instead of the expected HTTP 401, proving the route accepted a validly signed unsafe student account into downstream invite-join handling instead of failing closed at the auth boundary.

behaviorHardened: Signed invite-code join app sessions whose student account fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with student-session-required.
Unsafe signed student accounts are rejected before invite-code lookup, membership id construction, membership writes, or join-class-by-invite audit events.
The denial response preserves trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.
